embeds.title: v0.9.0 — a choice every dawn (1/2)
embeds.description:
⏳ **24 hours to a new season.** Monday 06:00 CET the board wipes — and for the first time, your PvP night isn't fixed. Every dawn brings a choice.

**NEW — DAILY BOONS**
Every player is offered the same three boons each dawn and picks one. It shapes that night's 22:00 league round alone — no stacking, no carry-over, no auto-pick if you sit it out.
Fourteen in the launch pool, three offered at a time — and never the same boon two dawns running.
• **Dragged Forward / Buried** — haul a rival's hindmost rat to their front, or bury their leader at the back.
• **A Body First** — a runt takes your front line so nothing better has to.
• **Silence** — a rival's leader forgets its trick. Its charms still work.
• **Rust / Stripped** — a rival's whole line loses its guard, or its leader marches out with its trinkets confiscated.
• **Barren** — a rival's warren has no room left to call up more rats.
• **Bulwark / Rearguard / Blunt** — thicken your leader, sharpen your rearguard, or dull a rival's.
• **Antidote** — your line shrugs off poison that would've felled it.
• **Guardian** — the first blows against your line land on nothing.
• **First Blood** — your leader strikes before anything can answer. It follows whichever rat ends up at your front, even if a rival's Drag or Buried put it there.
• **Deep Scout** — read every rival's line before you build yours.

footer.text: we ride at dawn · season resets Monday 06:00 CET
